text: Hi, come in. You mentioned in your email that you wanted to talk about the essay deadline? Yes, thank you. I have been ill this week and I am worried I cannot finish by Friday. I am sorry to hear that. How much extra time do you think you would need? If possible, three extra days would let me finish the last section properly. Three days is fine. Please email the student office so the extension is recorded officially. I will send them a message this afternoon. Thank you so much for understanding. Please include your course number in the email so the office can find your record. I will include the course number and the new deadline. That is everything. If you are still unwell on Monday, let me know before the deadline. I will contact you before Monday’s deadline if I need further advice.
